title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: each arm's chosen configuration over five seeds, on 300 of its own training links
description: The report run of the cost-of-meaning comparison, in expliCCit's design and, as a one-off for the paper deadline (user, 2026-11-18), in distribution: links 100 to 399 of net2's 600 training links, which the searches (exp-lcf-cost-search-316, exp-lcf-cost-teacher-search-318, links 0 to 99) did not touch, each under 2 of the training data's 64 conditions drawn with campaign seed 32, 30 s (experiments/comfort.py). Four configurations, each on training seeds 0 to 4, chosen on links 0 to 99 by the mean over seeds 0 and 1 and trained in exp-lcf-cost-teacher-317, exp-lcf-cost-teacher-seeds-321, exp-lcf-cost-315 and exp-lcf-cost-seeds-320: the taught arms, whose best configuration was the clone of BBRv3's logged steps alone (RL after it scored lower in both arms): lcft-paper-none (the actor on neto1 v1's seven values) against lcft-freefix-none (the same actor behind an encoder of neto1 v1's architecture with seven free latents, cloned together); and the faithful arms, offline CQL on Sage's reward: lcf-paper-c0.1-lr1e-4-n60k against lcf-free-c0.01-lr1e-4-n60k. BBRv3 is the reference. summary.md opens with free minus paper for each pair (experiments/arm_versus.py: per link the mean over the five seeds, then the mean over links with a 95% bootstrap interval), then each policy minus BBRv3 (experiments/rule_report.py).
prepare: P=(); for s in 0 1 2 3 4; do T="$IN/t"; F="$IN/p"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && { T="$IN/u"; F="$IN/s"; }; for c in lcft-paper-none lcft-freefix-none; do P+=(--policy "$c-s$s=$T/$c-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; for c in lcf-paper-c0.1-lr1e-4-n60k lcf-free-c0.01-lr1e-4-n60k; do P+=(--policy "$c-s$s=$F/$c-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 40 ]; for x in "${P[@]}"; do [ "$x" = --policy ] || [ -f "${x#*=}" ]; done; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec" --links 100:400 --seed 32 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-comfort"; cp "$OUT/spec/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --over-seeds; uv run python experiments/arm_versus.py "$OUT" lcft-freefix-none:lcft-paper-none lcf-free-c0.01-lr1e-4-n60k:lcf-paper-c0.1-lr1e-4-n60k lcft-freefix-none:bbr3 lcft-paper-none:bbr3 lcf-free-c0.01-lr1e-4-n60k:bbr3 lcf-paper-c0.1-lr1e-4-n60k:bbr3; { cat "$OUT/versus.md"; echo; cat "$OUT/summary.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.tmp"; mv "$OUT/summary.tmp" "$OUT/summary.md"
